# env panels (6HP)

| Directory | Contents |
|---|---|
| `front-pcb/` | Native passive FR4 panel `env-panel.kicad_{pro,pcb}`: 30.0 x 128.5 x 1.6 mm, NPTH only, F.SilkS labels. Generated by `../tools/build_layout.py` from `../docs/geometry.json` |

Holes: jacks Ø6.2, pots Ø7.2, LEDs Ø3.2, MODE / REC buttons Ø4.2, rail holes Ø3.2 at X12.58.
The buttons need the modules/8bit printed cap through their hole. No FreeCAD print panel yet.
